notes.title: 🚨 Important Announcement for Users! 🚨
notes.content:

If you're having trouble logging in through the website, please log in via the Steam launcher instead!

🔹 How to do this?
1️⃣ Launch sheepChat through Steam, not via the .exe file.
2️⃣ Steam login is working without issues.

notes.title: Apologies for the Downtime and a Bonus for Our Users ❤️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34002039/472796f7abe07a8b061add3810ae45264af62a91.png[/img]

Dear friends, 🐑💬 

We sincerely apologize to everyone who experienced issues using sheepChat over the past few days. 💔 Unfortunately, due to the blocking of subnetworks from our new hosting provider in some regions, particularly in Ukraine 🇺🇦, the app became partially unavailable. We understand how this impacted your experience and deeply regret that we couldn’t prevent this situation.  

The issue has now been resolved, and full access to the app has been restored. ✅  

As an apology, we’ve increased the TTS quota for Steam users with the paid version. 🎙️ Until January 15, 2025, your TTS quota has been doubled from 1500 to 4000 messages. This adjustment has already been applied for all users who purchased the app on Steam. 🚀  

We truly appreciate your patience, understanding, and support. 🙏 Your feedback helps us improve every day. If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to contact us via support or through our social media channels.  

We’d also be grateful if you could update your Steam reviews if the issue has been resolved for you. 📝  

Thank you for sticking with us, and once again, we apologize for any inconvenience caused. 💙  

With love,  
The sheepChat Team 🐑💬

notes.title: Release 1.9.150
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34002039/06fff1020b0e8e394c2f54b5b0461bbccfea4506.png[/img]

We are excited to announce the rollout of an update for sheepChat! 🚀

✨ New feature: now you can create custom themes for the chat window in gaming mode and for widgets. This feature is available to everyone in experimental mode and is waiting for your tests!

🛠 Fixes for YouTube: we have made a number of improvements and fixes to make your user experience even better.

🔧 Improvements for TikTok: we are working on improving the protocol, which should help solve connection issues for some users. If you experience connection problems with TikTok, we recommend using a proxy or VPN, for example, through the Netherlands.

🌐 Accessibility improvement: for users from Ukraine and countries with restricted access, we have deployed new servers and added new access points. This should provide higher speed and stable access to our servers.

We are incredibly inspired by these changes and look forward to your feedback! 💌

notes.title: Patch 1.9.139
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the new nightly build of sheepChat 1.9.139! 🌙✨

We have deployed new servers and added new access points in an experimental mode to provide users with improved and more stable access to the service. This is particularly relevant for residents of Ukraine and countries with censored internet. In theory, these changes should ensure a higher speed and stability when accessing our servers.

Improvements have also been made to the TikTok protocol aimed at resolving connection issues for some users. In light of recent events and news about TikTok, the service was supposed to become available in Russia and banned in the USA (and possibly other countries). If you are experiencing connection problems, try using a proxy (settings available in sheepChat) or VPN services for access, for instance, through the Netherlands.

We are tirelessly striving for excellence and doing everything possible to ensure that our product meets your requirements and is as user-friendly as possible.

This version is available on Steam, through the beta update channel in the "nightly-v1.x.x" branch.
Update and enjoy the improved performance! 🚀🌐

Dear sheepChat users! We are happy to introduce you to the new version of our app, in which we have significantly improved the emoticons system. We know that emoticons are a great way to express your feelings and mood in chat, so we have added the following features:

- Now you can add your own emoticons to the chat, both as local files and links to them. This allows you to personalize your communication and share your emotions with friends.

- We have also added full support for BetterTTV, with support for custom emoticons if you log in through Twitch. This gives you access to thousands of emoticons created by the BetterTTV community.

In the future, we plan to add support for other platforms of custom emoticons, such as FrankerFaceZ and 7TV.

We never stop working to make our app quality and functional for you. We hope you enjoy the new emoticons system, which allows you to express your emotions and mood in chat. We are grateful to you for your loyalty and support. You are our main goal and strength. We always look forward to your feedback and suggestions, so that we can improve our app according to your needs and preferences. Thank you for being with us! 😊

Release 1.9.102
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34002039/46eb510052285c9450881944b3ba41fd05c4862b.png[/img]

We are glad to announce the release of the update to version 1.9.102, which includes many fixes and improvements

One of the most significant changes in the current version of the chat is the new implementation of the speech synthesis queue system, which will improve the stability of its work.

1) The function of changing the playback speed has been improved, and the opportunity to change the tone of the voice has been added.
2) The black list has been corrected, and the opportunity to add entire phrases to the ignore list has been added. This will allow you to customize the program to suit your needs.
3) Now users can replace words and phrases in speech synthesis, which will allow them to create more customized settings.
4) An audio buffer overflow bug has been fixed, which resulted in the inability to play sounds and speech synthesis.

The new version includes fixes and improvements for the Facebook and Trovo platforms, as well as additional debug messages in the notification center.
An error connecting to the Kick platform has been fixed, and fixes have been made for Twitch.

We hope that these changes will help users to enjoy sheepChat even more and make it even more stable. 
Thank you for using our program!

notes.title: Intrusive notifications
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34002039/e61fec8f6f28003d77d3c21af3cb4b74d21a1045.png[/img]

After the release of the recent update, we began to receive numerous complaints from users about the notifications that many, many people did not like. We hasten to inform you that it is very easy to disable them - go to the notification settings and disable the "Debug messages" type (In the sheepChat settings, in the notification section, it is possible to customize or disable any type of notifications).
The messages that caused such a strong reaction were added so that you can track the status of your YouTube connection. And, if you are having connection problems, we advise you to leave this type of notification enabled or enable it when you have problems with YouTube.

notes.title: Connecting to YouTube
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34002039/163380e82d1955edb6f3105be43dfa5220a35e7d.png[/img]

At the moment, for YouTube to work correctly, you need to use a link to the channel. the chat is picked up only after the stream starts. You don't need to restart sheepChat for this purpose, if the YouTube chat doesn't pick Up after the stream starts, you can reconnect channels in the context menu of sheepChat.

Another problem with YouTube may be their protection from gray IP addresses, and we are currently working to fix this problem. A series of patches will be released soon to solve problems with connecting to YouTube.

notes.title: Release 1.4.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34002039/1f810ca7c322b7e2890c8bf1ca0505d430829476.png[/img]

We are discontinuing the release of 32-bit builds of the program for Linux. The current and all future builds of the program for Linux, starting from 1.4.0, will be 64-bit, builds for Windows will continue to be formed for x86 and x64. When installing the program on Linux x86, the latest stable version 1.3.5 for Linux x86 will be loaded.

In the new version, we fixed the quiet mode and added a hotkey Ctrl+Alt+M to it, as well as added a hotkey to clear messages Ctrl+Alt+K. The built-in Tor has been removed from the proxy selection, it may be returned in the future or something new will be added.

The protocols of YouTube, Twitch, Dlive, DonatePay, VK, DonationAlerts were also updated, the program components were updated to the current versions and other improvements in the core.

A new release with an updated emoticon system and text-to-speech is planned soon.

Dear user.
For your (and our) comfort, we have updated the site and added a feedback form where you can leave your suggestions, comments and feedback about our product. For individual support of premium users, a ticket system has been added, which should simplify and improve our communication with you.
The program was also optimized and now the chat works faster.

notes.title: Release 1.2.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34002039/eda82359bc7f06aade133666ae5ace0ca5cc8ca8.png[/img]

We have released a new version that everyone has been waiting for. 

The main change was the addition of cloud premium votes for users who bought the chat on Steam, and for those who downloaded it for free from our site. Also, a lot of corrections were made in the speech synthesis work and other minor errors received due to feedback.

Cloud voices have a limit - for premium users it is 500 voiced phrases per day, for free ones 50 per day(we estimate the load on the servers, and the numbers will change over time). 

For Valentine's day, we have prepared a gift for everyone - 5000 voice messages for premium users and 1000 for those who downloaded for free.

Happy holiday!

notes.title: Changelog 1.0.9
notes.content:
⚪ Ability to adjust the playback speed of speech synthesis
⚪ Fixed icons on YouTube channels
⚪ Fix pre-view links
ᅠ ⚫ Fixed bug for https://vk.com/doc208153438_470282925?hash=7f112206447b0963f2&dl=5ac57ced2804c786bc view links
ᅠ ⚫ Added support for GIF images from links to VK.com documents
⚪ Core optimization
ᅠ ⚫ Performance improved
ᅠ ⚫ All protocols (chat captures) are executed in the same process.
ᅠ ⚫ Main chat window and game mode are executed in the same process.
⚪ Other minor fixes and improvements

[h1]Note[/h1]
In previous versions, each protocol (chat capture) was executed each in its process, for example, if 3 channels were connected, 3 processes were created, each of which consumed> 50Mb RAM, now all protocols (chat captures) are executed in one process, which on average consumes 100Mb of RAM, depending on the number of connected channels, this significantly saves a lot of resources if more than one channel is connected. The same with the chat window, now both modes (main and game) work in the same process and consume 2 times less resources than before.

Also added a new function in the speech synthesis settings, which allows you to adjust the playback speed (the so-called), thanks to this, you can speed up the speech and change the voice intonation, if you greatly increase the playback speed, you can get a cartoon voice.

notes.title: Postponement of release
notes.content:
Dear friends! Steam asked to make small changes before publication, and therefore the release date is postponed to December 20, 2018.

Often asked about the conversion of premium license to the key in the Steam, such an opportunity will be and possibly even in the automatic mode through the personal account on our site, or on request. But after the conversion, the premium on the site will be irrevocably deactivated. Also in the Steam version will be missing some premium features, such as premium voice, because they need a premium license on the site, later we will make the integration between our site and Steam, that would return all the features and add Authorization on the site via Steam.
